items.item_text: MD, PhD, other doctoral degree, or comparable degree.

Demonstrated health-related research experience in clinical or health services research, including but not limited to: comparative effectiveness and outcomes research, delivery system/implementation science, artificial intelligence/machine learning, advanced analytics, personalized medicine (including use of genomics, proteomics and related data), clinical informatics, health economics, embedded research, health equity, health policy, improvement science, management science, public health, sociology, statistics, or systems engineering.
Expand a program of externally funded research in one or more of the core domains of clinical effectiveness and value, access to care, innovation in health care delivery and population health.
Establish productive collaborations with current faculty members to expand externally funded research at KPSOM.
Identify opportunities to partner with health system leaders to address health system priorities using diverse research methods and approaches.

Engage in scholarly activities that may include clinical effectiveness research; health services and health systems research; improvement and implementation research; research related to personalized medicine including implementation of innovations using genomics and related data; use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and large data models in health care; and health-related program and policy development and evaluation.[LC2.1][MG2.2]
Support and serve as a mentor to KPSOM students as they pursue both required and additional scholarly projects.
Serve as presenters and facilitators in large, medium, and small group learning sessions.
Scholarly and pedagogical duties, expectations, and resources will be individually developed based on evolving faculty interests, skills, departmental priorities, and needs.
Confirmed track record of first and senior author publication in journals of clinical medicine, population health, and health care research
Expertise in one or more clinical domains that would complement our current portfolio of research, including but not limited to expertise in cardiovascular disease, diabetes or surgical outcomes.
Demonstrated outstanding teaching and mentoring abilities and commitment to teaching.

Demonstrated ability or potential to obtain funding from diverse sources, including National Institutes of Health (NIH), Patient Centered Outcomes Research Institute (PCORI), private foundations, and/or industry
Proven strong collaboration and communication skills.
Demonstrated strong critical thinking, leadership, and organizational skills.
